sourceRefs.locator: Entry extract: c. 395–410, addition of survivors from Radagaisus’ force, negotiations with the empire, operations in Italy and the sack on 24 August 410
5.48.1–3: Jovius meets Alaric at Ariminum and sends demands including annual gold, grain and settlement to the emperor

summary.de: Anführer eines sich wandelnden Verbandes. Zwischen etwa 395 und 410 verhandelte und kämpfte er mit römischen Regierungen um Versorgung und eine dauerhafte Ansiedlung.
summary.en: Leader of a changing coalition. Between about 395 and 410 he fought and negotiated with Roman governments over supplies and a lasting settlement.
